critique: FAIL: 1. **Text Overlap**: The body text overlaps with itself due to insufficient line spacing. **Fix**: Increase `dy` values in `<tspan>` elements to `dy='2.5em'` for better spacing. 2. **Image Overlap**: The image overlaps with the descriptive text below it. **Fix**: Move the image up by changing `<image y='160'>` to `y='140'` or adjust the text position. 3. **Text Overflow**: The descriptive text at the bottom is cut off. **Fix**: Move the text up by changing `<text y='490'>` to `y='470'`.
